task: Three modules format a cents amount and each formats it differently, so the tests in tests/amounts.rs fail on all of them. The tests pin the one rule: an optional minus sign, the whole units, a dot, and two digits of remainder. Move that rule into a new module `src/money.rs` exposing `pub fn amount(cents: i64) -> String`, make `users`, `orders` and `invoices` each delegate to it, and declare the module from `src/lib.rs` so the test can reach it as `money`. Do not change the tests, and keep the three existing public functions where they are.
